notes: PH provisional receipt (newspaper subscription), hand-filled. Printed header gives vendor and VAT TIN. The amount exists ONLY as hand-written words - 'THREE HUNDRED PESOS' - never as digits, so digit-based grounding will correctly refuse it and the field must come back null with the receipt flagged. total_amount is recorded here as the true value for accuracy reference, but 300.00 is not expected to be extractable by a digits-only pipeline. Date is hand-written and illegible.
